title: mutant-coupling-null: a chance-corrected test of mutant-real-fault coupling

creators.name: Andrés, César
creators.affiliation: CRIA-BDHS Research Group, Escuela Politécnica Superior de Tecnología y Ciencia, Universidad Camilo José Cela, Spain

description: Research artifact for a chance-corrected test of mutant-real-fault coupling. The primary question is whether a fault-triggering test satisfies the historical unique-kill coupling criterion more often than a coverage-matched ordinary non-triggering test on the same kill matrices. Original code is MIT-licensed. Defects4J, Major, and other third-party tools remain under their upstream licenses and are not redistributed here. No coupling estimates are archived in this version. GitHub: https://github.com/cesar-andress/mutant-coupling-null
